dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: If you're here for treatment, please register a brief description of your condition in advance...

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: In a manner of speaking. My actual post is combat medic.

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: Everyone is tightening their belts these days, so we save what we can.

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: When we are not on assignment, we also treat civilians to help provide more adequate medical care.

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: However, our medical services for civilians are only open at set times each week, so please make sure you do not come at the wrong time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if my arms and legs feel sore, and I'm dizzy with a stiff neck...?

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: No obvious external injuries, then? And no symptoms like fever?

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: The equipment I have here is limited. I mainly handle external injuries and common colds, so I would suggest visiting a proper medical facility for a more thorough examination.

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: What you described could also be the result of overexertion, or poor sitting posture.

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: Excessive stress and bad habits can both lead to physical discomfort... Please be careful and take this seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm fine. I don't need a doctor.

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: Good. Then do your best to stay that way.
